keyPoints.heading: Your brain is lying to you every morning
keyPoints.description: Willpower fails 92% of the time within 3 months. Stanford research shows systems beat motivation. This is why New Year resolutions collapse by February.

keyPoints.heading: The 2-minute rule that destroys procrastination
keyPoints.description: Shrink any habit to under 2 minutes to start. James Clear used this to write daily for 3 years straight. Starting small removes all friction.
